INSPECTION OF FRONT SPEED SENSOR

1. INSPECT SPEED SENSOR

(a) Disconnect the speed sensor connector in the engine compartment.

(b) Measure the resistance between terminals.
Resistance: 0.8 — 1.3 kΩ
If resistance value is not as specified, replace the sensor.

(c) Check that there is no continuity between each terminal and sensor body.
If there is continuity, replace the sensor.

(d) Connect the speed sensor connector.

2. INSPECT SENSOR INSTALLATION

Check that the sensor installation bolt is tightened properly. If not, tighten the bolt.
Torque: 195 kg·cm (14 ft·lb, 19 N·m)
